reviews.text: Excellent experience from start to finish. Caleb made a real effort to understand our needs and translate them into a design that fit exactly what we were looking for. Very attentive, thoughtful, and easy to communicate with. Would definitely recommend.

I was very satisfied with the remodeling of my pool, deck and patio, from initial contact with Selah through to its completion.  Caleb, the sales associate/designer,  took the time to answer our questions about the pool components.  John, the project manager, kept us closely posted personally, and via email, as the work progressed. I would certainly recommend them to others.

Wow, we can't say enough good things about Selah Pools! They turned our backyard into a total paradise, and the whole experience was stress free. We obtained several quotes and designs from other pool companies before deciding on Selah. From day one, they were super responsive and really listened to exactly what we wanted and I am very particular. The construction process was smooth, and the pool turned out absolutely beautiful.
